 Judgment

2. Petitioners are aggrieved by Exts.P3 and P4 eviction notices.

Admittedly, the petitioners challenged the same by filing an appeal as evident by Exts.P5 and P6.
3.

When this Writ Petition came up for consideration before this Court on 25.08.2025, this Court passed the following order:
"The learned Government Pleader takes notice for the 2025:KER:76453 first respondent.
Issue urgent notice before admission by speed post to the respondents 2 to 4.

The respondents may file their statements/counter affidavits, if any.
2.

On a consideration of the facts and materials on record, especially that Exts. P5 and P6 appeals are pending consideration before the fourth respondent, I am satisfied that the petitioners are entitled to an interim order.
Hence, I direct the respondents 2 to 4 not to enforce Exts. P3 and P4 eviction notices till the date of the next hearing.

" 
4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the considered opinion that this Writ Petition need not be retained here.
There can be a direction to consider Exts.P5 and P6 within a time frame and till then the interim order can continue.

Therefore, this Writ Petition is disposed of in the following manner:
1. The 4th respondent will consider Exts.P5 and P6 appeals filed by the petitioners after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioners, as expeditiously as possible,
at any rate, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.

 Judgment
This writ petition is filed seeking the following reliefs:
"i. issue a writ of certiorari or any other appropriate writ, order or direction, quashing Exhibit P3 and P4 eviction notices issued by the 3rd respondent;
ii. issue a writ of mandamus directing the 4th respondent to consider and dispose of Exhibit P5 and P6 appeals within a time frame fixed by this Hon'ble Court;
iii. dispense with the production of English translation of vernacular documents;
iv. grant such other reliefs as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
"[SIC]
